avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Antiplatelet and anticoagulant effects may potentiate thrombotic risk already increased by epoetin alfa
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplemental vitamin E above dietary amounts; monitor for signs of thromboembolism

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May enhance erythropoiesis and increase hematocrit synergistically, elevating thrombotic risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient to discontinue ginseng supplements

caution_supplements.name: Iron supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Epoetin alfa increases iron demand; supplementation is often necessary and beneficial for efficacy
caution_supplements.action: Coordinate iron supplementation with prescriber; monitor ferritin and transferrin saturation regularly

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin B12 and Folate
caution_supplements.mechanism: These are cofactors for erythropoiesis; deficiency can reduce epoetin alfa effectiveness
caution_supplements.action: Ensure adequate dietary intake or supplementation as directed; baseline labs recommended

avoid_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
avoid_foods.mechanism: Epoetin alfa increases thrombotic risk and blood pressure; sodium exacerbates hypertension
avoid_foods.action: Recommend DASH diet and sodium restriction <2300 mg daily; monitor blood pressure

caution_foods.name: Iron-rich foods (red meat, spinach, fortified cereals)
caution_foods.mechanism: Support adequate iron availability needed for maximal epoetin alfa efficacy
caution_foods.action: Encourage consistent dietary iron intake; monitor iron parameters

caution_foods.name: Foods high in B vitamins (leafy greens, eggs, poultry)
caution_foods.mechanism: Provide cofactors necessary for effective erythropoiesis
caution_foods.action: Ensure adequate dietary sources; supplementation may be needed if deficient

monitoring_notes: Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit, blood pressure, iron panel (ferritin, TSAT, serum iron), platelet count, and signs of thromboembolism (DVT/PE/stroke) at baseline and regularly during therapy. Assess for adequate nutritional iron and B vitamin status, as deficiencies impair epoetin alfa response and increase adverse effects.
